question: Which three sender addresses sent the largest total value, in raw IMD units (18 decimals), summed over Transfer(address,address,uint256) logs emitted by 0xd34a99bc0f67ae1bbd63c660e6d0b0dd03e263b7 on chain 1 during the 24 hours ending at the latest finalized block when requested? Highest first, ties by ascending address, positive totals only, excluding the zero address.

definitions.window: The observation covers the last 24 hours ending at the latest finalized block available when requested. Resolve this once to inclusive fromBlock and toBlock; state reads use toBlock.
definitions.missing: If any required data is unavailable, inconsistent or incomplete, report inability; do not encode unknown as zero, false or an empty list.
definitions.event: event Transfer(address indexed from,address indexed to,uint256 value)
definitions.metric: Sum value grouped by indexed from. Include every recipient; exclude zero sender (minting). Deduplicate by blockHash, transactionHash and logIndex. Keep positive totals only.
definitions.ordering: Descending total, then ascending numeric address. Return up to 3 unique addresses; a complete empty scan returns [].
